description:
About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Senior Executive Search, GOC

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Search who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media’s regional teams (Europe, United States and Asia). 
Support the implementation of digital campaigns and ads according to guidelines with platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, Search Ads 360, etc. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines. 
Monitor campaigns daily on each of the platforms and ensure accuracy of data across platforms for campaign reporting. 
Generate daily campaign reports for reporting to regional Search teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of experience implementing paid Search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, etc. 
Advanced Excel skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

description:
About the job

About The Role

The Revenue Marketing team is responsible for generating and accelerating the pipeline that grows Shopify's business with mid-market and upmarket merchants. We're looking for a Senior Lead, Demand & Digital Field Marketing to create demand across AMER Sales Segments.

You will be the marketing counterpart of our sales leaders rely on: the person who turns their territory priorities into programs that produce qualified pipeline. You'll lead the strategy on sales play, signals, and digital field programs. That means a quarterly play calendar built against real opportunity types (new logo, expansion, competitive displacement, closed-lost win-back), buying signals actioned into outreach that reps actually run, and a portfolio of virtual events, webinars, gifting, and incentive programs that create demand.

You'll partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns so the top of the funnel and the plays underneath it point at the same accounts.

We're looking for a leader who is equally comfortable in a territory review with sales leaders and demand programs. You set the bar for execution quality, and you're measured on quality pipeline. Your key KPIs are inbound and outbound Sales Accepted Leads (count and value), in alignment with the AMER sales team's targets.

Key Responsibilities:


Responsible for the AMER sales play system: build the quarterly play calendar against pipeline targets,land it with sales leadership, and execute to drive pipeline
Own pipeline generation numbers in Sales forecast calls and be able to translate Marketing-led programs into pipeline impact
Equip reps with plays they will actually run: clear positioning, ready-to-send outreach, supporting content, and a defined follow-up motion
Turn product, account, and intent signals into prioritized outreach and campaign triggers, and define which signals matter most to action
Partner with sales and funnel operations on routing, follow-up SLAs, and speed to lead so signals convert instead of aging
Own our digital-first field portfolio: virtual events, executive roundtables, webinars built as demand programs, gifting and incentive programs, and activations around major industry moments
Partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns and paid programs that reach priority accounts and feed consistent, quality pipeline
Report performance to marketing and sales leadership weekly in a form that drives decisions, and build measurement into every program before it launches
Put AI agents and tooling to work on program build, reporting, and campaign production. 



Qualifications


Strong track record of building demand or field marketing programs that hit pipeline and revenue targets in B2B SaaS, ecommerce, or technology
Direct experience partnering with sales leaders as a peer. Bring a strong spirit of collaboration and “win together” attitude
Demonstrated ownership of Sales pipeline and programs, including sales plays or account-based programs
Experience running virtual events, webinars, and executive programs as pipeline vehicles, with clear before-and-after numbers
Strong analytical skills. You're fluent in funnel and pipeline data, can interrogate a dashboard, and can design an experiment with a hypothesis and a kill criterion
Working knowledge of the modern marketing and CRM stack (marketing automation, CRM, intent and signal data, campaign attribution)
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can compress a complicated program into a paragraph a sales leader will read
Keen interest in AI and a habit of putting agents and tools to work on your own programs, reporting, and production
Resilient and resourceful in the face of ambiguity, and able to thrive on change rather than endure it
Strong understanding of the ecommerce market, mid-market merchant needs, and the competitive set



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change

description:
About the job

Description -

Role Overview

HP North America Consumer & Retail Marketing is looking for a Retail Marketing Execution Lead to drive the execution, coordination, and delivery of retail marketing plans across key retail partners.

This role is responsible for leading the retail execution team and ensuring that marketing plans move from strategy into high-quality, on-time execution across accounts, channels, and campaigns. The role sits at the center of retail delivery, working closely with Retail Growth Managers, category teams, media, eCommerce, content, analytics, finance, agencies, and sales.

The ideal candidate is a strong operator and people leader who can bring structure, urgency, and clarity to complex retail marketing execution. This person should be comfortable managing a team, orchestrating multiple workstreams, solving problems quickly, and making sure the organization delivers with consistency and excellence.

This is a critical role for someone who enjoys turning plans into action, connecting teams, improving how work gets done, and ensuring retail marketing execution supports business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Retail Execution Team

Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for retail marketing execution across key North America retail partners.

Set clear priorities, roles, responsibilities, and ways of working for the team.

Create a strong operating rhythm across the execution team, ensuring visibility into workload, timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, speed, and continuous improvement.

Ensure the team is focused not only on completing tasks, but on delivering high-quality retail marketing that drives impact.

Orchestrate Retail Marketing Delivery

Own the end-to-end coordination of retail marketing delivery across accounts, campaigns, product launches, promotional moments, and key business priorities.

Partner with Retail Growth Managers and category marketing leads to translate account strategies and business priorities into clear execution plans.

Coordinate across internal and external teams to ensure assets, content, media, messaging, offers, timelines, approvals, and reporting are aligned.

Proactively identify execution risks, bottlenecks, gaps, or dependency issues and drive resolution with the right stakeholders.

Ensure retail marketing plans are delivered on time, on brand, and with a strong connection to business objectives.

Drive Retail Campaign and Account Execution

Support execution across key retail accounts including Best Buy, Amazon, Walmart, Costco, Staples, Office Depot, and other strategic retail partners.

Ensure strong delivery of retail campaigns, seasonal moments, product launches, in-store and online activations, retail media programs, and account-specific marketing plans.

Partner closely with eCommerce, content, retail media, and analytics teams to ensure retail plans are connected across the full customer journey.

Help create consistency in how retail plans are built, tracked, communicated, and measured across accounts.

Ensure account teams have clear visibility into deliverables, status, next steps, and performance.

Improve Retail Operating Rhythm

Build and manage the operating rhythm for retail execution, including weekly status tracking, campaign timelines, execution reviews, issue resolution, and leadership updates.

Create stronger visibility across the retail marketing calendar, major initiatives, deadlines, and dependencies.

Improve how work flows between Retail Growth Managers, category teams, content teams, media teams, agencies, and sales.

Simplify processes where possible and create scalable ways of working for retail execution.

Help the organization move from reactive execution management to more proactive planning and delivery.

Performance, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

Partner with analytics, retail media, eCommerce, and sales teams to understand campaign performance and execution impact.

Ensure learnings from retail campaigns are captured and used to improve future execution.

Support leadership reporting with clear updates on execution status, risks, progress, outcomes, and key decisions needed.

Connect execution quality to business impact, including traffic, conversion, sell-through, market share, revenue, margin, and partner priorities.

Help define what great retail execution looks like and how the team measures progress against it.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader and execution driver who can operate in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

They are highly organized, proactive, and comfortable leading through complexity. They know how to connect strategy to execution, manage multiple stakeholders, and keep teams focused on what matters most.

This person should bring a strong retail mindset, a bias for action, and the ability to create clarity when many teams, timelines, and priorities are moving at once.

They should be comfortable pushing for quality, accountability, and speed, while also building strong relationships across marketing, sales, media, analytics, agencies, and retail partners.

Required Experience

7+ years of experience in retail marketing, marketing operations, channel marketing, shopper marketing, eCommerce marketing, campaign execution, or related roles.

Experience leading or managing a team.

Strong experience managing complex cross-functional marketing execution across multiple stakeholders and timelines.

Experience working with retail partners, retail media, eCommerce, in-store marketing, content, or account-based marketing programs.

Strong project management and operational leadership skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities, resolve issues, and drive decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Strong communication skills, including the ability to create clear updates, executive-ready summaries, and action-oriented meeting structures.

Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills. Experience with project management, workflow, dashboarding, or reporting tools is preferred.

Preferred Experience

Experience in consumer technology, retail, consumer electronics, or a fast-paced retail environment.

Experience working with major retailers such as Best Buy, Amazon, Walmart, Costco, Staples, Office Depot, or similar partners.

Experience working closely with sales, category marketing, retail media, eCommerce, analytics, finance, and agencies.

Experience improving operating models, building execution processes, or leading transformation of marketing delivery.

Familiarity with retail calendars, promotional planning, product launches, retail media, and digital shelf/content execution.

Key Skills

People leadership and team development.

Retail marketing execution.

Cross-functional orchestration.

Strong project and process management.

Ability to influence without direct authority.

Strong communication and stakeholder management.

Problem solving and decision-making.

High attention to detail.

Ability to simplify complexity.

Strong bias for action.

Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.

What Success Looks Like

The retail execution team has clear priorities, ownership, and operating rhythm.

Retail marketing plans are delivered on time, with stronger quality and fewer last-minute escalations.

Retail Growth Managers and category teams have better visibility into timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.

Cross-functional teams are better aligned across retail, category, media, eCommerce, content, analytics, sales, and agencies.

Retail campaigns and account plans are executed with greater consistency and stronger connection to business outcomes.

Processes are simpler, more scalable, and easier for teams to follow.

Leadership has clear visibility into retail delivery progress, risks, and performance.

Position Summary

This role is ideal for someone who wants to lead the retail execution engine for a large, complex marketing organization. The person will be responsible for leading the team that turns retail strategy into action, orchestrating delivery across multiple accounts and functions, and improving how HP shows up with retail partners and customers.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Joining the Fleet Team offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of one of the fastest-growing companies. This role, driven by data, requires a combination of consumer-focused analytical thinking and strong interpersonal skills. You'll work closely with a dedicated team to build and manage DiDi's business across all Spanish-speaking LATAM (SSL) regions. Expect a fast-paced, dynamic, and challenging environment with never a dull moment!

The Vehicle Solutions team plays a crucial role in DiDi’s continued expansion throughout SSL by focusing on strategies for acquiring, converting, and retaining additional supply.

Ideal candidates should have strong strategic thinking and analytical abilities, excellent time management and organizational skills, and be prepared to lead by example. Whether it's designing new incentives, identifying areas for improvement, evaluating implementation options, or collaborating with our global engineering team on new features, you'll be constantly looking for scalable solutions that contribute directly to DiDi's growth in Mexico and LATAM.

In this role, you'll be...


Hunter – New Business Prospecting & Cold Outreach: Proactively identify, map, and engage high-potential companies through cold prospecting and outbound outreach, building a strong pipeline from scratch and reaching the right decision-makers.
Account Analysis & Prioritization: Leverage market data, opportunity size, unit economics, and conversion potential to segment and prioritize accounts based on expected business impact.
Commercial Proposal Development & Negotiation: Understand prospect needs, build compelling value propositions and business cases, and lead commercial negotiations through deal closure.
Data-Driven Pipeline Management: Track and analyze key funnel metrics, including pipeline size, conversion rates, time-to-close, potential vs. activated volume, and account performance to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
Partner Activation & Growth: Collaborate cross-functionally to translate signed agreements into tangible business results, ensuring fast implementation and identifying opportunities to increase volume and performance post-launch.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


A strong hunter mindset, with proven experience in cold prospecting, outbound outreach, and building new business pipelines from scratch.
Strong commercial skills, with the ability to engage senior decision-makers, uncover business needs, negotiate, and close complex deals.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, feeling comfortable working with numbers, analyzing data, sizing opportunities, and translating insights into commercial actions.
A highly results-oriented approach, with strong ownership and a clear focus on measurable business impact, conversion, and growth.
Excellent communication (Enlglish and Spanish) and influencing skills, with the ability to build compelling value propositions, structure business cases, and clearly articulate business impact.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

The CX Operations Analyst will play a key role in building the foundation of Customer Experience analytics at Crunchyroll. Initially, the role will focus heavily on Tableau and Salesforce reporting, supporting stakeholders across Customer Experience, Operations, Product, and Business teams. Over time, this position will evolve into a broader CX Analytics role with opportunities to perform advanced analysis, identify drivers of customer behavior, uncover root causes of customer friction, and influence strategic business decisions.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data and wants to grow from reporting and visualization into advanced analytics and customer insights.

Build and support Salesforce dashboards and reports used by CX leadership and operational teams.

After this period, the position will be remote, with availability to work from the Mexico City office whenever needed. About the Company Our client is a global provider of AI-powered legal technology, eDiscovery, digital forensics, information governance, and data recovery solutions. The organization helps law firms, corporations, and government agencies navigate complex litigation, compliance, investigation, and data management challenges through innovative technology and specialized professional services. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining mission-critical eDiscovery software used by legal teams around the world. You will use AI tooling daily for code generation, review, test, and debugging, and you will verify its output before it ships. You will also mentor junior engineers, including on responsible and effective use of AI in software development, and contribute to the design discussions and code reviews that keep the codebase healthy. Experience owning production systems from debugging, resolving, and learning from live incidents Daily fluency with AI development tooling, paired with the judgment to verify and take responsibility for what it produces Strong written and spoken communication, suited to distributed teams working across time zones Mission and core values Our mission is to bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests. Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other. Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About the job

LealUp es la plataforma de Customer Success con IA para empresas B2B con ingresos recurrentes en Latinoamérica. Lo que en el mercado se llama "posventa" lo resolvemos en un solo lugar: la vista 360 de cada cliente, health score, WhatsApp nativo, renovaciones, cobranza y encuestas NPS. Nuestros agentes de IA preparan QBRs, resumen cuentas, detectan riesgos y activan playbooks.




Creemos que la retención es el motor principal de crecimiento de una empresa B2B. Para la mayoría de las empresas de la región, el principal competidor no es otro software. Es el Excel y el WhatsApp personal de cada ejecutivo.




Buscamos a nuestra primera persona de Customer Success en México.




El rol




Vas a acompañar a nuestros clientes desde la firma hasta la renovación, y a construir cómo se hace Customer Success en LealUp en México. No vas a heredar un playbook de 200 páginas, vas a escribirlo. Y vas a gestionar tu cartera dentro de LealUp, así que tu trabajo diario también va a mejorar el producto.




Lo que vas a hacer en los primeros 12 meses




→ Liderar el onboarding y la implementación de clientes con nuestro proceso de 7 etapas. Que cada cliente vea valor en las primeras semanas, no en meses.

→ Gestionar una cartera de cuentas B2B: adopción, health score, QBRs, renovaciones y oportunidades de expansión.

→ Detectar a tiempo las señales de riesgo y de expansión, y actuar con playbooks antes de que un cliente se vaya en silencio.

→ Ser la voz del cliente dentro del equipo: llevar a producto lo que ves en cada cuenta y participar en las decisiones del roadmap.

→ Adaptar nuestro mensaje, procesos y materiales al mercado mexicano: vocabulario, comités de compra, facturación y formas de trabajar.

→ Trabajar con partners y aliados locales en implementaciones conjuntas.

→ Medir lo que importa: retención, NRR, tiempo hasta el primer valor y adopción.




Lo que buscamos




→ Al menos 3 años en Customer Success, Account Management o implementación, en SaaS B2B o en empresas de servicios con contratos recurrentes.

→ Experiencia gestionando onboarding, renovaciones y conversaciones difíciles con clientes, incluidas las de cobranza y riesgo de baja.

→ Manejo de métricas de posventa: churn, NRR y health score, y saber usarlas para decidir, no solo para reportar.

→ Experiencia con algún CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive o Zoho).

→ Comodidad para usar WhatsApp como canal profesional con clientes.

→ Español excelente, escrito y hablado, e inglés intermedio para leer documentación y herramientas.

→ Residencia en México. Si estás en CDMX o Monterrey, suma, porque habrá reuniones presenciales ocasionales.




Suma, pero no es requisito




Haber trabajado en una startup en etapa temprana, haber implementado una plataforma de Customer Success (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat, Totango u otra), experiencia con IA aplicada al trabajo con clientes, o participar en comunidades de Customer Success en LATAM.




Lo que ofrecemos




→ Trabajo 100% remoto desde México.

→ Trabajo directo con los fundadores, sin capas intermedias.

→ Una silla en la mesa para decidir cómo crece LealUp en México.

→ Influencia real sobre el producto: lo que veas con clientes se construye.

→ Salario competitivo del mercado







El proceso

Conversación con los fundadores, un caso práctico sobre una cuenta real de ejemplo (por ejemplo, un plan de rescate para un cliente en riesgo o la preparación de un QBR), una conversación final y la oferta. De la primera conversación a la oferta, 2 semanas como máximo.

Si te incomoda la ambigüedad, necesitas procesos definidos desde el primer día o prefieres administrar cuentas en lugar de construir cómo se gestionan, este rol no es para ti. Y está bien.

Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

title: Experience Management Manager
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

You will lead the team responsible for the experience consistency of DiDi Premier, our flagship high-end product designed to redefine urban mobility through a better and reliable experience. Our mission is to curate a seamless ecosystem where every touchpoint—for both passengers and drivers—reflects a premium standard.

We are looking for an experienced operator and people leader to own the experience control system for DiDi Premier. You will define and evolve the standards that govern what Premier means in practice, run the audit programs that make compliance signals trustworthy, and own the enforcement architecture that keeps Premier's experience floor non-negotiable.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead and develop a team of analysts while staying close enough to operations to make sound calls on audit design, enforcement edge cases, and market expansion readiness. You will partner across the organization—operations, customer experience, supply, demand, and product—to ensure compliance signals translate into clear, trusted, well-applied processes across the business.

In this role, you'll be...

Own the Experience Control System: You will own the end-to-end Premier compliance architecture — the service standards governing category access, driver presentation, vehicle appearance, cancellation behavior, and service execution; the mystery shopper program that audits compliance across in-trip and out-of-trip channels; and the enforcement architecture that turns audit signals into consequences (warnings, retraining gates, suspensions, category removal, and the requalification path). You will calibrate enforcement to be firm but fair, with documented due process appropriate to each market's labor context, and revise standards based on audit outcomes, passenger feedback, and partner inputs.

Build the Cross-Functional Operating Model: You will design and operate the system through which Experience Management connects to the rest of the business — standardized weekly compliance outputs, agent-facing materials that explain enforcement decisions clearly, structured stakeholder communication cadence, and clear intake processes for cross-functional requests. Internal stakeholder satisfaction is a measurable outcome you own.

Validate Outcomes, Not Just Activity: You will close the loop between compliance metrics and real outcomes — passenger ratings, partner satisfaction, driver sentiment, and retention. When compliance improves but ratings don't, you will revise standards rather than double down on enforcement.

Lead Market Expansion Readiness: You will lead the Experience Management contribution to Premier launches in new markets — adapting standards to local context, deploying mystery shopper infrastructure, certifying local agent teams, and ensuring audit coverage thresholds are met before each market's launch date. You will travel to set up quality infrastructure on the ground.

Lead the Team and Operate with Discipline: You will manage a team of analysts across compliance and audit, driver sentiment and communications, and process governance. You will define clear scope per role, hold a weekly cadence, develop bench depth, and build a team that operates without bottlenecking through you. You will set realistic deadlines and meet them, proactively flag delays before they affect downstream stakeholders, and resolve cross-functional friction directly.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The right background: 5+ years of experience in mobility, marketplace, premium hospitality, aviation, or franchise operations, with at least 2 years of people management. You have run audit programs, mystery shopper operations, BQA-style quality systems, or equivalent enforcement functions in a high-volume operational context. Strong working proficiency in SQL or Python — you can interrogate audit and compliance data directly, design metrics that survive scrutiny, and partner credibly with data teams on signal design.

A systems mind for compliance: You think about quality control as architecture — standards, audit, enforcement, recovery, feedback loops — not as a series of one-off audits. You can articulate why compliance systems fail at scale and how to design around those failure modes. You believe that "good enough" is the enemy of "premium," and you build systems that protect that distinction at scale.

Strong people and cross-functional leadership: You scale through your team — delegating ownership rather than tasks, holding a weekly cadence, giving direct feedback, and building people who can operate without you. You believe stakeholder communication is real work, not overhead. You set clear expectations, flag risks early, and treat front-office enablement as part of the job. You're comfortable in environments where your function generates productive friction with other teams.

A bias for action in the field: You don't wait for a roadmap; you build one. You navigate ambiguity, identify the right people to influence, and drive workstreams to completion. You move fluidly between desk-based system design and on-the-ground operational work — visiting partners, observing audits in person, and traveling to support new market launches.

Cultural fluency across LATAM: You operate naturally across Mexico and the broader region, and can adapt operating models to local context without losing brand consistency. Spanish and English fluency required.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

The Lead, e-Commerce AI Business Enablement guides the artificial intelligence journey of LATAM eCommerce business. It is a senior individual contributor role for a curious builder: someone who turns AI capability into commercial results across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers, and who helps the whole regional organization work smarter along the way.

You'll have real freedom to explore, prototype and test ideas — and the backing to scale the ones that succeed. Some experiments won't work, and that's part of the deal. What matters is learning fast, being honest about results and turning the wins into everyday practice across the region.




Where You'll Make an Impact




Your energy will center on three missions:




Mission 1 | Drive Commercial Growth

Build the insight-to-action engine that accelerates revenue and profitability across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers.

What you'll do

Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability.
Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days.
Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say.

Success looks like

Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together.

Mission 2 | Evolve Ways of Working

Champion continuous improvement across the LATAM eCommerce organization: simpler processes, less manual work and good ideas that travel across markets.

What you'll do

Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them.
Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets.
Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change.
Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick.

Success looks like

A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries.

Mission 3 | Explore, Test and Scale AI

Take AI from ideas to everyday practice through experimentation: try, test, learn and scale what works.

What you'll do

Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value.
Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants.

Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage.
Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies.

Success looks like

AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge.

How You'll Operate

Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices.

Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency.
Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view.

A natural arc for the first 12 months, which we'll shape together.

Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential.
Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't.
Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it.

What You'll Bring

Experience and skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.

Hands-on comfort with SQL and Python, plus working command of LLM APIs and frameworks (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation), enterprise automation (Power Platform, n8n, Make) and advanced Power BI.
Confident, clear communication with senior stakeholders, in writing and in the room.

English: full professional proficiency. English is the working language with regional and global leadership, and parts of the selection process are conducted in English.

Experience with AI governance, model evaluation and data privacy in enterprise environments.

Experience scaling solutions across multi-country organizations.

We move with rigor — we measure what we try and we're honest about results — and we treat every experiment, successful or not, as progress.

description:
About the job

Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. You then jump into the CMS to publish updated landing page content requested by the Program team. Mid-morning, you join a sync with Product Managers to align on an upcoming registration flow change and plan the corresponding site updates. After lunch, you review A/B test results, document findings, and share recommendations with the Commercial team. Your customer is the prospective seller in Mexico who needs a clear, frictionless path from search result to completed registration.

About The Team

The Seller Marketing Team owns the full marketing funnel for Amazon Mexico's seller ecosystem. The mission: make Amazon the first choice for every business in Mexico looking to sell online. The team attracts potential sellers, converts them into registrations, and keeps them engaged and growing. This means working across awareness, acquisition, and retention, always with a bias toward experimentation and measurable impact. The culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and seller-obsessed. Team members take ownership of outcomes end-to-end and partner across product, program, and commercial functions to deliver results

Basic Qualifications


 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Experience in A/B testing
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision
 Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields
 Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with a variety of design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Fireworks, Visio, Axure, and Dreamweaver
 3+ years of editor, content strategist, technical writer, or content developer experience

description:
About the job

Sobre la empresa y lo que buscan

Vuela Fundación es una organización mexicana sin fines de lucro que, desde 2012, acompaña a niños con cáncer sin seguridad social con apoyo médico, económico, psicológico y social, de forma 100% gratuita. Trabaja dentro de hospitales públicos de la Ciudad de México y Chihuahua, y en 2025 destinó más de $4 millones de pesos a medicamentos, estudios y cirugías. Es donataria autorizada, cuenta con la acreditación de institucionalidad y transparencia del Cemefi y hoy se prepara para abrir su primer centro de atención y crecer a nivel nacional. Conoce más en vuela.org.

Esta posición reportará a la Gerencia de Marketing, Alianzas e Inversión Social y trabajará de cerca con las áreas de Operaciones y Comunicación. Es una posición de arranque profesional, pensada para alguien que quiera abrir relaciones con negocios, marcas y personas, y convertirlas en alianzas y donativos constantes, con posibilidad real de crecer junto con la organización.

Se busca a una persona que construya relaciones con facilidad, dé seguimiento sin pena, proponga ideas creativas y, sobre todo, tenga un interés genuino por el impacto social.

 

Responsabilidades principales

Alianzas con negocios y marcas

Prospectar y contactar negocios locales y PyMEs de consumo (tiendas, restaurantes, gimnasios y más) para sumarlos como aliados
Diseñar con cada aliado una estrategia de recaudación e impacto social a la medida de su marca y su operación
Promover e implementar ventas especiales con un porcentaje donado a Vuela, y darles seguimiento para convertirlas en alianzas de largo plazo
Desarrollar colaboraciones y productos con causa con marcas reconocidas en México
Organizar eventos locales en alianza con marcas y negocios
Colocar y recolectar alcancías en negocios, escuelas y con voluntarios, y hacer crecer esta estrategia

Donantes individuales y crowdfunding

Crecer la comunidad de donantes recurrentes mensuales, tanto en número de personas como en ticket promedio
Dar atención y seguimiento a los donantes actuales: renovar donativos vencidos y preparar comunicados
Aumentar el número de personas que crean campañas de crowdfunding a beneficio de Vuela y acompañarlas para que alcancen su meta
Desarrollar y vender productos con causa con la marca Vuela, en línea y en eventos

Campañas y seguimiento

Coordinar las acciones de recaudación de Septiembre Dorado, el mes del cáncer infantil
Preparar, en conjunto con Comunicación, los materiales de cada alianza y campaña
Llevar un seguimiento ordenado de prospectos, aliados y proyectos, y reportar avances contra metas

 

Requisitos y Calificaciones

Indispensables

Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Negocios, Comunicación o afín
1 a 2 años de experiencia en ventas, marketing, alianzas o recaudación (cuentan prácticas y proyectos)
Facilidad para construir relaciones de confianza y de largo plazo
Disciplina para dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y proyectos
Seguridad para presentar en público y representar a la organización
Creatividad para proponer campañas atractivas para distintas marcas
Manejo de Google Workspace
Excelente ortografía, redacción y comunicación verbal

Deseables

Experiencia vendiendo o haciendo alianzas con negocios de consumo
Experiencia en empresas sociales, startups u organizaciones de la sociedad civil
Experiencia en recaudación de fondos, crowdfunding o programas de donantes
Conocimiento de WordPress, Mailchimp o herramientas de publicidad digital

 

Perfil ideal

Buscamos a una persona que disfrute conocer gente nueva y construir relaciones de confianza que duren, no ventas de una sola vez. No es indispensable que tenga mucha experiencia; lo más importante son sus habilidades interpersonales, su iniciativa y su capacidad para organizarse y dar seguimiento a cada prospecto sin que nadie se lo pida.

Es fundamental que se sienta cómoda presentando frente a grupos y representando a la organización, que piense de forma estratégica y que tenga un interés genuino por el impacto social, con un estilo profesional. Es un puesto ideal para alguien con uno o dos años de egresado que quiera crecer en un ambiente de startup social dinámico, flexible y exigente.

About the job

Buscamos Account Manager – Mid Level

• Enfoque colaborativo, con ganas de sumar y hacer equipo.

• Conocimiento del Marketplace de Amazon, así como otros top Marketplaces mundiales. 




• Formación en publicidad, comunicación, ADE, marketing o similares. 




• Experiencia usando herramientas de reporting, gestión de proyectos o dashboards. 




 




En nuestro equipo compartimos estos valores: 




• People always come first → Las personas están siempre en el centro de nuestras decisiones.

• Contrato a jornada completa. 




• Proyecto estable, con impacto real desde el primer día. 




• Plan de crecimiento profesional y aprendizaje continuo. 




• Ambiente horizontal, exigente, colaborativo y con buen humor. 




• Retos continuos para seguir creciendo y creando nuevos proyectos. 




• Posibilidad de crecer dentro de una de las agencias más especializadas y en expansión del sector. 




 




Si te motiva un proyecto donde puedas liderar, proponer, aprender y crecer con tus cuentas, escríbenos a talent@amazingagency.io o aplica directamente. ¡Nos encantará conocerte!

description:
About the job

About the job




This is the role at the center of how our portfolio actually runs. When a maintenance issue pops up, when a cleaning schedule needs to flex, when a vendor needs to be dispatched, when a guest situation needs a judgment call — you're the call. You make decisions in real time, lead the team on shift, own the outcomes, and use AI daily to do it smarter. 




HomeHop Property Management is the top-rated short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO) property manager in Ohio, with properties across Cleveland, Akron, Columbus, Cincinnati, Pittsburgh, and Indianapolis. We're growing fast, and the quality of our real-time operations is a huge part of why.




This is a remote role, working on US Eastern time.




What you'll own




• Run live operations across our portfolio — triage, decisions, coordination, follow-through

• Lead the guest messaging team during your shift — set priorities, answer their questions, and have their back when issues escalate• Triage maintenance issues — troubleshoot remotely when you can, dispatch vendors when you can't

• Coordinate cleaning teams when schedules shift or issues come up• Use AI tools to work smarter — from triaging guest messages to drafting communications to building workflows that scale. We expect you to push the envelope on what AI can do in property ops.

• Make cost-effective decisions in real time — balancing guest experience with company resources

• Document every issue and resolution cleanly so the next shift has a complete picture

• Decide what needs to be escalated and what you should solve on your own




Who you are




• Sharp problem-solver who can assess risk and urgency in seconds

• Confident decision-maker — you don't freeze when something goes sideways, and you don't need three approvals to act

• Strong people skills — you'll be leading a team, coordinating vendors, and supporting guests, and tone matters in every channel

• Tech-fluent and comfortable across the stack — Slack, Asana, PMS software, and AI tools are part of your daily flow

• Self-directed and dependable in a remote environment• Genuinely excited about AI — not just "open to using it," but actively curious about how AI is reshaping how operations work. We use Claude daily and want someone who'll find new ways to use it, automate the boring stuff, and help us stay ahead.




Nice to have (not required)




• Experience managing teams• Engineering background is a plus. You think systematically, debug methodically, and stay calm when things break.• Maintenance, facilities, or hands-on property experience• STR, hospitality, or real estate experience• Vendor management experience




Why you'll want this job




• Real authority and trust — you make the call. No bureaucracy, no waiting on approval.

• A core seat on the operations team — you're not on the sidelines, you're running things, and you've got a team around you

• You'll be on the frontier of AI in property operations — we're not waiting for other companies to figure it out, we're building it. If you want to grow your AI skills in a real production environment, this is the place.

• A clear path to grow as the company scales — we're building toward 400+ properties and beyond, and the people who help us get there will lead the next chapter

• A culture that's always open to constructive feedback — we want to know how things could be better, and we move on good ideas fast

• A young, ambitious, tech-forward team that takes our work seriously and ourselves less so

• Direct access to leadership — you'll work with the founders, not three layers below them




The details




 Schedule: Five days on, two days off — Wednesday and Thursday are your off days. Monday and Tuesday are afternoon/evening shifts (approximately 4–10 PM ET), and Friday through Sunday run longer afternoon-through-evening shifts (approximately 1–10/11 PM ET) to cover peak guest activity. About half of your shift typically overlaps with the rest of the operations team, and the guest messaging team is on for your full shift — you're never operating alone. 40–45 hours per week on average.
 Compensation: $2,500–$2,700 USD per month, depending on experience

description:
About the job

Holafly is a fast-growing start-up 🚀that is changing how travelers connect to the internet abroad. ✈ We are a young and international team of over 600 people based worldwide! 🌎

About The Position

Holafly is on the hunt for top-tier talent to assist in the global growth of our Affiliate Program. We partner up with a variety of third-parties, and establish a long-term, performance-based partnership with them in order to drive sales to Holafly.Your mission as a Digital Account Executive is to drive growth through strategic affiliate partnerships and campaigns. Leveraging your travel industry expertise, you will create data-driven campaigns to promote travel products and services, maximising revenue and aligning with business goals. By managing affiliate relationships and tapping into regional trends, you’ll expand our brand presence and deliver measurable results in the US and Canadian markets.

Identify and actively recruit new affiliate partners and revenue drivers Own a curated portfolio of up to 80–100 affiliate partners, building individual account plans and executing quarterly growth roadmaps for them.

Identify and pursue strategic opportunities to grow Holafly's market presence through high-quality affiliate partnerships.

Background in managing large-scale performance campaigns in US and/or Canada

Technical Stack: Proficiency with the Impact platform and a strong command of SEO tools (specifically Ahrefs)

Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Excellent project and time management skills.


Extras


Technical or digital marketing certifications are a plus.
Existing network within the tech or travel industry

Flexibility: Results-oriented culture with flexible working hours to ensure work-life harmony
Growth Budget: Dedicated funds for your continuous professional development

During a trip to Thailand, Pedro and Lidia, the founders of Holafly, experienced the frustration of not having an internet connection.

Inspired by their own experiences, they came up with a simple but brilliant idea: why not allow travellers to buy data plans for any destination from their home country?

Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do.

We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

title: CRM Operations & Support Specialist
skills: Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

Be the users' advocate. You sit in on training sessions and working sessions and watch how people actually use the system. When a button says "Book the IC" on a deal whose IC is already booked, you notice, you understand why the user is confused, and you get it changed.

Own the feedback loop. Our US beta Slack channel gets forty posts a day: bugs, how-do-I questions, data problems, ideas. You triage every one: answer directly when you know the solution and pass on what you can't solve yourself. You keep the Salesflow feedback tracker current and make sure the backend team does not forget backend issues and the frontend team does not forget UI/UX issues.

Fix what you can, hand off what you can't. With AI as your pair, you fix copy, FAQ entries, help content and data corrections directly; small UI changes are within reach for the right person but are not the bar. For anything deeper you write a precise brief: what happened, for whom, how to reproduce it, what you already ruled out.

Own the in-app help: short videos, screenshots, and written walkthroughs, which today are generated automatically, high quality but unmonitored. You are the human who monitors changes, corrects, and adds what is missing.

Test before it ships. Before a release you click through the affected flows as a salesperson would. You keep a living checklist of the paths that matter. You are the last person who touches a feature before a user does.

Keep people unblocked. Login problems, access requests, a lead in the wrong stage, a deal that will not close. You resolve them, you write the how-to so it does not come back, and when the same question arrives three times you propose the change that makes it stop.

Grow with the rollout. As Salesflow expands to new markets and absorbs our marketing systems, the volume and variety of feedback grows with it. You build the process that scales, and you are the first person our new markets meet when they get stuck.

You have systems sense. You look at a user's screen and see the cause behind their specific issue. You ask why something was built the way it was before you decide it is wrong. You can hold a salesperson's workflow and an engineer's constraints in your head at the same time. People who have this usually come from product, implementation or solutions roles, from operations jobs where they were the one who "understood the system", or from an engineering or analytical background. Sales experience helps but is not required; we can teach you how our sales team works in a month. We cannot teach the above.

You are AI-augmented, not AI-dependent. You use Claude, ChatGPT or similar every day to do real work. You ask it critical questions, read its answers skeptically, catch it when it is wrong, and know when a task needs a human developer. If you are uncomfortable working with AI tools, this is not the role for you.

You have delivered things. Experience level matters less than evidence that you finish what you start. That could be a job in operations, support, product, or QA, or something you built yourself. Tell us about it.

You write clearly. Most of this job is written: Slack replies to users, briefs to developers, FAQ entries, AI prompts. Your English is fluent, precise, and clear. Spanish or Portuguese is a bonus for our upcoming markets.
You have drive. Nobody will hand you a ticket queue. You will see the mess, decide what matters, and go.
Experience in system design or algorithms
Experience with a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) as an admin or power user
Experience supporting a software product in production
Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
$1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!
Psychologist on staff
Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

You are the reason a salesperson in Los Angeles gets an answer in ten minutes even if the developer is across the world and asleep, and the reason the same question is not asked again next week.

This is not a support desk role and it is not a QA role, though it contains both. It is not a developer role either: you will not be asked to write production code. It is the seat from which the whole feedback loop is owned.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

Employee Assistance Program

On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

description:

The company provides tailored solutions for individuals, businesses (Open English Business), and children (Open English Junior). It has also expanded its offering to include French, Italian, and Portuguese programs through Open Mundo. About the Role




We're hiring two Marketing Analysts, one focused on Google & Search and one on Meta & Paid Social. Both roles answer the same question: where should our next marketing dollar go, and what will turn it into a valuable customer?

You'll connect campaign data with what happens after someone becomes a lead: sales conversations, purchases, product choices and customer value. AI will be central to how you work. Tell apart ads that attract curiosity from ads that acquire customers

What you bring




Strong quantitative reasoning. You break ambiguous problems into testable questions and defend your conclusions.
Evidence that you build with AI. You've built a workflow, automation, tool or prototype, and you can explain how you validated it and where human judgment is still needed.

Ownership and clear communication. You go from spotting a problem to recommending a fix and helping implement it.

title: AI-First Copy & Community Manager
skills: Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.
Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.
Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.
Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.
Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.
Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.
A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.
Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.

You write copy that sounds right for the brand and gives people a reason to care. You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.




AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology.




We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.




We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

TE Connectivity's Product Pricing Teams determine the price of new and existing products by evaluating cost, marketplace, competitor data, economic conditions, volume, and quality of the product, as well as market positioning.

What Your Background Should Look Like

Position Summary - The Product Pricing Analyst III supports the Industrial Business Unit by driving pricing decisions through data analysis, pricing intelligence, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for managing product pricing, evaluating pricing effectiveness, identifying margin improvement opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations that support profitable business growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen and the ability to influence stakeholders across Sales, Program Management, Finance, Customer Service, and business leadership teams.

Education
