title: Marketing Coordinator
skills: Dirigir al equipo de Marketing (analista, diseñador y practicante): distribuir cargas de trabajo, establecer prioridades, dar seguimiento a entregables y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos del área.
Desarrollar al equipo a través de retroalimentación continua, definición de objetivos individuales y participación en el proceso de evaluación de desempeño de la organización.

Definir y ejecutar el plan anual de marketing alineado a las prioridades de la Dirección Comercial, traduciendo los objetivos de venta en campañas por servicio, temporada, vertical o cuenta objetivo (ABM).
Diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar campañas digitales de generación de demanda (mailing, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, SEO y contenido web) con metas explícitas de leads calificados y costo por lead.
Administrar el CRM y las herramientas de automatización de marketing (HubSpot): segmentación, listas, etiquetas, workflows, calificación de leads e integridad de la base de datos.

Construir y mantener el tablero de indicadores del área —leads generados y calificados, costo por lead, tasa de conversión por etapa, oportunidades atribuidas y ROI por campaña y por evento— y presentarlo mensualmente a la Dirección Comercial.
Analizar el desempeño de cada iniciativa y proponer decisiones de reasignación de presupuesto sustentadas en datos, discontinuando las acciones que no generan retorno.

Planear, coordinar y ejecutar la participación de la marca en aproximadamente 18 ferias, expos y eventos de industria al año: presupuesto, proveedores, producción de stand y materiales, logística, comunicación previa, agenda de citas del equipo comercial y seguimiento posterior de contactos en el CRM.

Medir el retorno de cada evento (costo total, contactos capturados, leads calificados y oportunidades generadas) y sustentar con datos la recomendación de mantener, ajustar o retirar cada feria del calendario del siguiente año.
Apoyar directamente al equipo comercial con materiales de venta, presentaciones, casos de éxito, fichas de servicio y campañas de seguimiento que aceleren el ciclo de venta.

Liderar las iniciativas de digitalización del área: automatización de procesos, integración de herramientas y uso de inteligencia artificial para investigación, generación de contenido y eficiencia operativa.
Gestionar el sitio web y la estrategia de contenido (SEO, blogs y artículos técnicos) para incrementar el tráfico orgánico calificado y la visibilidad de la marca.
Gestionar las redes sociales corporativas (LinkedIn, Facebook e Instagram): contenido, calendario, pauta y medición del rendimiento.

Asegurar la consistencia de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto, definiendo y supervisando lineamientos visuales, tono de comunicación, materiales comerciales, eventos y material de comunicación interna en coordinación con Recursos Humanos.
Desarrollar y negociar con proveedores de material publicitario, promocionales y regalos corporativos, asegurando calidad, tiempos de entrega y las mejores condiciones de compra.
Coordinar la logística de envío de materiales y promocionales a las oficinas foráneas, cumpliendo con los tiempos comprometidos por el equipo comercial con el cliente.
Administrar el presupuesto anual de marketing, dar seguimiento al ejercicio del gasto y justificar cada inversión con resultados medibles.
Realizar estudios de benchmark y análisis de la competencia en el mercado de freight forwarding para identificar oportunidades de posicionamiento y diferenciación.
Aprobar los materiales, contenidos y piezas de comunicación generados por el equipo, asegurando la consistencia con la identidad corporativa antes de su publicación o producción.
Alta capacidad de análisis cuantitativo: interpretar datos de campañas y del CRM y convertirlos en decisiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Liderazgo y supervisión de equipos de trabajo: capacidad de distribuir cargas, dar retroalimentación y desarrollar talento junior.
Dominio avanzado de Excel y de herramientas de visualización de datos para construir reportes y tableros de indicadores.
Orientación comercial: comprende el ciclo de venta B2B y opera como socio del equipo de ventas, no como área de soporte.
Mentalidad de retorno de inversión: define métricas antes de ejecutar y sostiene o descarta iniciativas con evidencia.
Dominio de plataformas de CRM y automatización de marketing, preferentemente HubSpot: segmentación, workflows, calificación de leads y reportes de atribución.
Sólidos conocimientos de SEO, SEM, pauta digital (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta) y analítica web (Google Analytics).
Capacidad probada de organización y logística para operar en paralelo un calendario alto de ferias y exposiciones.
Alta capacidad de negociación con proveedores, así como manejo de procesos de pago y facturación.
Sólida capacidad de comunicación escrita y verbal, incluyendo la redacción, edición y presentación de resultados ante dirección.
Autonomía, sentido de urgencia y capacidad de priorizar múltiples proyectos simultáneos con supervisión mínima.
Rápida adaptabilidad a cambios en procesos y prioridades, y capacidad de trabajo bajo presión.
Disponibilidad para viajar y para trabajar horas extendidas o fines de semana durante la operación de eventos.
Conocimientos mínimos deseables en logística internacional para procesos de embarques marítimos, aéreos y terrestres.
Inglés intermedio, capaz de escribir y establecer conversaciones de negocios.
Licenciatura en Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Relaciones Comerciales o afín.
De 5 a 7 años de experiencia en marketing B2B con responsabilidad directa sobre generación de demanda y reporte de resultados; deseable en freight forwarding, logística o transporte.
Experiencia comprobable administrando plataformas de CRM y automatización de marketing (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar).
Experiencia comprobable en la coordinación integral de ferias y eventos de industria, incluyendo presupuesto, proveedores y medición de resultados.
Experiencia gestionando presupuesto de marketing y reportando retorno de inversión a nivel dirección.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años liderando equipos de marketing, incluyendo perfiles creativos y analíticos.
Sueldo atractivo de acuerdo con experiencia.
Vales de Despensa.
Fondo de Ahorro 10%.
30 días de aguinaldo.
Plataforma integral de salud digital Weehealth.
SGMM y Seguro Dental.
Esquema Híbrido (Después de contrato indeterminado).

description:
About the job

About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

The Social GTM Manager sits at the center of SharkNinja's social ecosystem, ensuring our organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, creator commerce, listening, and analytics teams operate as one integrated growth engine.

This role is equal parts strategist, operator, and connector. You will translate business priorities into coordinated social activation, ensuring product launches, retail moments, campaigns, creator programs, media investments, and commercial priorities are aligned and executed seamlessly across channels.

You are not a channel owner — you're the connective tissue. Working across Social, Media, Brand, Retail, E-Commerce, Communications, Product, and Analytics, you'll create the systems, planning processes, reporting frameworks, and operating rhythms that allow our teams to move faster, stay aligned, and maximize impact.

If you thrive on bringing order to complexity, love connecting teams around a common goal, and get energy from helping high-performing organizations operate at their best, this role is for you.

What You'll Do


Own and maintain the global social GTM calendar across organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, creator commerce, listening, and analytics.
Build integrated launch plans that connect social activity to product launches, retail moments, promotional events, media investments, and broader business priorities.
Ensure creators, content, media, and commerce strategies are coordinated from planning through execution.
Partner with category, channel, and regional leaders to identify opportunities for amplification, integration, and scale.


Cross-Functional Orchestration


Serve as the primary liaison between Social and key business functions, including Brand, Media, Retail, E-Commerce, Communications, Product, and Analytics.
Drive launch readiness across social workstreams, ensuring timelines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables remain on track.
Surface risks, gaps, and opportunities early, helping teams proactively solve problems before they impact execution.
Ensure social plans are integrated into broader marketing and commercial initiatives.


Social Ecosystem Excellence


Connect organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, and creator commerce efforts into a cohesive full-funnel activation strategy.
Partner with Media teams to ensure creator, influencer, and organic content are leveraged effectively across paid channels.
Support the development of scalable playbooks, processes, and operating models that improve performance and speed.
Help evolve Social from a collection of channels into a measurable business growth engine.


Reporting & Business Intelligence


Own reporting cadences across the social ecosystem, including weekly updates, launch recaps, monthly business reviews, and executive communications.
Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into activity, performance, and business impact.
Translate social performance into clear, actionable insights for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Standardize reporting processes across regions, categories, and channels.


Process & Operations


Build and document workflows, launch processes, briefing templates, approval chains, and operational playbooks.
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions that improve visibility, accountability, and execution quality.
Manage intake processes and prioritization frameworks for social support requests.
Continuously improve how the social organization plans, communicates, and executes globally.


Attributes & Skills (Requirements)


5+ years of experience in Integrated Marketing, Social Media, Marketing Operations, GTM, Program Management, or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of the modern social ecosystem, including organic social, influencer marketing, paid social, affiliate marketing, creator commerce, social listening, and analytics.
Experience connecting marketing activity to business outcomes, product launches, retail priorities, and commercial objectives.
Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong analytical mindset and comfort translating data into actionable business insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level communications and stakeholder management.
Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Monday, Notion, Airtable, Smartsheet, or similar.


What Success In This Role Looks Like


Product launches, campaigns, creator activations, and retail moments are coordinated seamlessly across the social ecosystem.
Leadership has clear visibility into social priorities, activity, performance, and business impact.
Teams spend less time chasing information and more time executing.
Organic, influencer, paid social, affiliate, and creator commerce efforts operate as one integrated system rather than independent channels.
Social is recognized as a strategic growth engine that connects brand, creators, media, commerce, and culture.


YOUR ROLE in DIVERSIFYING 


As a corporate citizen, learn and support SharkNinja's Diversity, Equity & Inclusion strategy
Be an Ally, find internal Champions
Explore SharkNinja's Employee Resource Groups or volunteer to serve on committees that organize diversity-related events and activities
Participate in employee engagement surveys and respond as openly and honestly as possible
Become culturally competent; take the time to learn about different cultures, races, religions and backgrounds represented by your colleagues
Treat people in a way they wish to be treated rather than the way you wish to be treated


YOUR ROLE in leading our SUCCESS DRIVERS & representing our UNIQUE MINDSET 


Leads us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
Using your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE,”
Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT.”


Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn More About Us

 Life At SharkNinja

Outrageously Extraordinary

description:
About the job

INTRODUCTION TO THE ROLE

The Social Media and Content Officer plays a key role in shaping Girls Not Brides’ digital presence through social media, creative content, and audience engagement. The role is responsible for developing and delivering social media approaches, creating engaging visual and multimedia content and translating organisational priorities, stories, and evidence into accessible, audience-focused communications.

The role will act as a key source of creative and visual insight, developing high-quality content including graphics, video, photography and digital assets, while supporting the consistent application of the Girls Not Brides brand across communications materials, influencing moments, projects and initiatives. The postholder will help bring organisational priorities, stories, and evidence to life through creative and accessible communications, ensuring content is tailored for different digital audiences and channels.




ABOUT YOU

You are a creative and audience-focused communicator with a passion for visual storytelling, social media, and digital engagement. You enjoy experimenting with different formats, identifying creative ways to communicate ideas, and producing content that connects with audiences.

You are organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple content requests while maintaining high standards of quality and consistency. You understand the importance of accessible, inclusive and ethical communications and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to bring stories to life across multimedia and social media channels.




Job location 

Mexico City, Mexico.

Working as a global team, all Girls Not Brides’ team members may from time to time be expected to work outside normal working hours (e.g., early morning or early evening) this is not a regular occurrence and is only to accommodate collaboration of teams across different time zones. This role may require some international travel, as necessary.




Accountable To

Communications Manager




Salary range 

Market competitive based on a detailed survey by the Birches Group of comparable national NGO salaries in selected location. Payments will be made in local currency of where it is located.




Contract

This is a fixed term contract for 2 years. The successful candidate must have the right to work in Mexico at the time of applying, and for the full duration of the two-year contract.




KEY RESPONSIBILTIES




Social media and digital audience engagement

Develop and implement social media strategies, plans and approaches, translating communications strategies and plans into effective social media activity that supports external engagement and organisational goals.
Develop and deliver tailored social media plans, calendars, scheduling, and content (copy/visuals) aligned to organisational brand, messaging, moments, key audiences, and priorities.
Contribute to regular audience mapping and analysis with colleagues across external engagement, feeding in insights from social media performance, trends, and opportunities.

Monitor and evaluate social media performance, using data, audience insight and trends to continuously improve audience engagement and inform adaptation of social media approaches.
Manage day-to-day social media activity independently, proactively monitoring key audiences and identifying and acting on emerging opportunities within agreed priorities and escalating issues where appropriate.
Works proactively with colleagues across teams to integrate timely and strategic social media approaches in planning for key moments, campaigns, launches, and other activities.
Work collaboratively with media and communications colleagues to identify and respond to relevant breaking news, emerging opportunities, and organisational priorities through timely social media activity, using judgement to determine appropriate approaches and escalating where required.




Digital communications and creative content

Produce engaging, high-quality multimedia content, communications materials and collateral, including graphics, videos, photography and other communications assets that support organisational priorities, publications, and influencing moments.
Develop creative concepts and narrative approaches for content that translate organisational priorities into compelling content across digital channels, publications, campaigns and influencing moments.
Apply editorial judgement to ensure all multimedia content is accurate, inclusive, accessible and aligned with organisational messaging, visual brand identity, and ethical storytelling principles.
Work collaboratively with communications colleagues to develop approaches that strengthen written content, media opportunities, publications and other communications outputs through multimedia storytelling.
Identify and maintain a bank of independent creative suppliers and partners, including designers, illustrators, photographers, videographers and other content producers, coordinating commissioning, contracting and delivery within agreed projects and budgets.
Ensure visual consistency and adherence to brand standards across communications outputs and provide visual guidance and support to colleagues across the Communications Team and wider organisation where appropriate.

Communications Team engagement 

Work closely and collaboratively with other communications team colleagues to deliver integrated communications.
Work collaboratively as part of cross-functional project teams, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to support the development of communications plans, approaches, and content gathering aligned to organisational priorities.
Support report design and visual presentation of organisational materials.
Support the maintenance of communications assets, content libraries, and editorial resources to support efficient content production and knowledge management.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of Communications Team content calendars and forward planning processes, ensuring social media activity, multimedia content and creative production are coordinated with wider communications priorities and key moments.
Contribute to the Communications Team planning, learning, and connection, contributing to a high-performing, cross-geography team.
Undertake monitoring and evaluation to inform and support learning and improved audience engagement over time.
Contribute to other cross-team communications activities as required.




Wider Organisational Responsibilities

Support copywriting, proofreading and translation of communications outputs across our core languages as required
Commit to the mission and vision of Girls Not Brides, putting these at the forefront of all planning, work and actions.
Uphold the core values of Girls Not Brides in all areas of work and interactions with colleagues, members, partners, and other stakeholders.
Comply with Girls Not Brides’ policies and processes, including for safeguarding, diversity and inclusion, the code of conduct and data protection.
Ensure that internal databases and monitoring information are kept fully up-to-date.
Commit to ongoing personal development and learning.
Fulfil any other reasonable requests for the advancement of Girls Not Brides.




QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential 

Experience in digital communications, social media communications, or related fields in the not-for-profit sector, an international /intergovernmental organisation, a social movement, or social enterprise.

Experience living and/or working in Asia, Africa, and/or Latin America & the Caribbean.




Safeguarding

Girls Not Brides is committed to ensuring all staff and partners operate in safe environments. The postholder must uphold safeguarding standards at all times and report any concerns promptly through the appropriate channels.




Diversity and Inclusion

We value diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities. Girls Not Brides is committed to creating an inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to thrive.




How to apply 

The closing date for applications is 17:00 BST on Friday,16 October 2026.

To apply, please click the "Apply Now" button on the job page and submit your CV along with a brief cover letter clearly demonstrating how you meet the role requirements.




Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage interested candidates to apply early. Please note that the vacancy may close before the advertised closing date if enough suitably qualified applications are received.




Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.




Please note: This is a single Social Media and Content Officer position. While the role is advertised in Kenya or Mexico it may be based in any of these locations, only one appointment will be made.

About the job

Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values


Inclusive – we succeed together
Trusting – we choose to trust each other
Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
Future Focused – we accelerate change
Curious – we turn knowledge into action


Role Purpose 

We are seeking a results-driven and highly organised campaign specialist to join our B2B Growth Marketing team. This role is responsible for coordinating and delivering integrated marketing campaigns that support new logo acquisition, customer expansion, and commercial objectives across Wood Mackenzie’s Financials & Traders customer vertical.

Working closely with the Campaign Leads and Director of Growth Marketing for Financials & Traders, you will play a key role in supporting and executing customer campaign management - driving channel performance improvements and journey management. You will collaborate cross-functionally with sales, product marketing, content, digital, and operations teams to ensure the seamless execution of campaigns that resonate with target personas within whitespace opportunities and move them through the buyer’s journey.

Key Responsibilities


Own and support the execution of integrated campaigns across channels including email, paid social, display, SEM, SEO, content syndication, and nurture flows. 
Work with event operations and sales to drive execution excellence in event planning, on-site execution, and follow-up - increasing ROI from this critical channel. 
Support the execution of webinars and third-party marketing activities, coordinating delivery, logistics, follow-up, and lead handoff processes. 
Partner with digital marketing and media teams to manage paid acquisition efforts, ensure targeted reach into ICP audiences and accounts, and continuously improve tactics through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and optimisation. 
Own campaign workflow management, including scheduling, task coordination, stakeholder communication, and project tracking. 
Manage campaign setup and deployment activities, including emails, landing pages, nurture programmes, audience lists, and campaign assets. 
Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure campaign governance, lead management processes, and data quality standards are maintained. 
Work closely with sales and lead management teams to support effective lead routing, follow-up, campaign readiness, and conversion strategies. 
Monitor campaign execution and performance in real time, providing regular status updates and highlighting risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement. 
Track, report, and analyse campaign performance against KPIs such as MQLs, SALs, cost per lead, and pipeline contribution - using insights to inform post-campaign reviews and future activity. 


Requirements


Experience executing integrated B2B marketing campaigns across multiple channels. 
Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing campaign delivery from briefing through to execution. 
Familiarity with marketing automation, attribution and data platforms such as Salesforce, Pardot, Dreamdata, or similar. 
Experience supporting webinars, virtual events, lead generation programmes, or customer marketing initiatives. 
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to execution excellence. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global, matrixed teams. 
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns within Financial Services, Commodities, SaaS, Tech, or related sectors. 
Knowledge of marketing operations processes, lead management workflows, and campaign automation. 
Experience using project management platforms such as Asana, or similar. 
Experience working within global marketing organisations. 
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. 


Expectations 

This is a hybrid role and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least two days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, though this may be subject to change.

description:
About the job

Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the Role?

The Manager, Buyer & Case Support is responsible for developing and managing T3 support specialists to handle and continuously improve the one-to-one support experience, with a strategic focus on providing exceptional support for Etsy's most valuable buyers. This team embodies our "north star" mission, turning 1:1 interactions into opportunities to build brand advocates. This manager will monitor and optimize the day-to-day operations of the Buyer Support team and work seamlessly with internal partners and EOPs (Etsy Outsourcing Partners) to provide a feedback loop on the buyer experience.

To be successful in this role, the Buyer Support team must meet and maintain key customer experience goals such as CSAT, Total Resolution Time, Escalation Rate, and First Touch Resolution rate. The team will also be focused on improving workflows in order to continue to scale our operations and better the customer experience.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Sr. Manager, Human Support.

What does the day-to-day look like?


Championing the Tier 3 buyer experience. Identify areas for improving the buyer experience, particularly for Etsy's most valuable customers, and additional workflows like executive escalations and more.
Identifying Subject Matter Experts who can lead the development of training, content, and quality rubrics for front-line T3 agents and EOPs in partnership with Enablement.
Monitoring and partnering with Enablement and Partner Success Management to improve vendor-level CSAT and EOP QA scores.
Providing steady leadership to a specialized team handling complex, T3 buyer escalations.
Hiring, assessing, and coaching team members; provide career mentoring to further develop promotable candidates.
Meeting the operational and experience goals set for the team, appropriately prioritizing and making tradeoffs when needed.
Holding the team accountable to a standard of quality, both in their support interactions with Etsy customers and in any project work performance, while being accessible and receptive to the team’s concerns and feedback.
You’ll tap the appropriate talent on your team to execute and supervise projects along the way.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.


Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:


7 years of overall work experience with 4 years of experience in customer support and managing a team.
An ability to motivate teams to do their best work, balancing authority, reserve, and approachability.
Comfort analyzing and reporting on data.
Experience communicating and translating technical issues to business stakeholders.
Experience with support tools (e.g. Zendesk) and AI tools.


Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Mexico Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

description:
About the job

Job Description



As a Contribute & Grow Partner, your main focus will be to enable the Grow & Contribute agenda by implementing global people processes, supporting leaders with insights, and building capability through training, coaching, and development. You translate global frameworks into practical local solutions, helping teams grow, develop, and perform through strong processes and meaningful employee experiences. 



This Hybrid role reports into our People Manager and is based out of Mexico Support Office.



A Day in the Life 



Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities:



Process Implementation



Drive high-quality implementation and adoption of global Grow & Contribute processes by embedding them into day-to-day operations, ensuring relevance to local context while maintaining global intent and standards. 
Act as the local subject-matter partner for Grow & Contribute, enabling leaders, HR Business Partners, and HR Generalists to confidently own and consistently apply people processes and tools. 
Act as a bridge between global design and local reality, representing local needs and constraints while reinforcing consistency in philosophy, principles, and ways of working. 
Facilitate, curate, and implement relevant learning programs, supporting local adaptations and strategies. 
Align performance development and learning processes with goals and organizational objectives. 

Insights & Support



Monitor effectiveness, adoption, and outcomes using data and feedback; translate insights into concrete improvement actions and provide structured input to global HR PLC Specialists / SMEs to strengthen process design and usability. 
Support the Head of People / People Manager with specialist insight and analysis to inform people strategy, prioritization, and forward-looking decisions linked to business needs. 
Measure and analyze leadership performance and development needs. 

Capability Building & People Development. 



Build sustainable people and leadership capability through training, enablement, and coaching, ensuring long-term, independent application of processes and practices. 
Provide personalized coaching to managers for targeted skill development. 
Facilitate leadership development interventions based on local needs. 
Coach people leaders on goal setting, performance metrics, and improvement strategies. 


Qualifications



Who You Are: 



Relevant university degree (e.g. Human Resources, Business Administration, or similar). 
Experience implementing and enabling people processes in complex, multistakeholder environments, with accountability for adoption and outcomes. 
Ability to translate global frameworks into practical, locally workable solutions while maintaining consistency and intent. 
Proven capability to partner with leaders and HR stakeholders to build capability, influence behaviour, and drive sustainable change. 
Data-informed and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to use insights to strengthen execution and impact. 
Strong facilitation, communication, and collaboration skills, with confidence to operate independently across functions, markets, and regions. 
Advanced proficiency in both English and Spanish. 


Additional Information



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.



We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 



At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 



25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
In addition to our global benefits, our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. 

We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability 



We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years 



You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues 



We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work 



You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits 



We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community

Influirás de manera importante en el diseño e implementación de soluciones consultivas de ingeniería B2B, optimizando indicadores críticos como productividad, eficiencia operativa, costo total de propiedad (TCO) y retorno de inversión (ROI).
Formación universitaria concluida en carreras de Ingeniería o Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia o Desarrollo de Negocios.

+3 años de experiencia en una función de gestión de portafolio, idealmente dirigido a maquinaria del sector comercial o industrial (B2B). Afinidad por la innovación y la tecnología, con interés por el desarrollo del negocio de la línea de robots profesionales de limpieza (KIRA)
Inglés conversacional avanzado.
